purpose: A small approximate-coordinate discovery screen for Lake Sampaloc; it is not a lake-boundary search or fish inventory.

taxonFilter.checkResult: The GBIF species endpoint resolves key 204 to class Actinopterygii.

spatialScope.coordinateBasis: Approximate query center used only to screen indexed records; it is not a source-reported coordinate, validated lake polygon, or boundary geometry.
spatialScope.interpretation: The narrow box is not a complete spatial representation of Lake Sampaloc and must not be interpreted as covering the whole lake.

limitations: This is one country-, taxon-, coordinate- and bounding-box-filtered GBIF occurrence search, not a survey or lake checklist.
The approximate coordinate box is not a verified Lake Sampaloc boundary; occurrences elsewhere in the lake or records without coordinates fall outside this screen.
A zero result does not establish fish absence, current ecological condition, or absence of records under other names, locations, or filters.
No species, diet, geometry, current-presence, or public app assertion was admitted.
nextAction: Obtain an authoritative or reusable Lake Sampaloc geometry before any geometry-based discovery search; continue to treat occurrence results as candidate records requiring record-level geography, identification, date, and reuse review.
